Sleep regularity

SRI: minute-by-minute sleep/wake agreement between consecutive days (100 = identical schedule). Consistency: the same agreement against a weighted window of the previous four days (Whoop-style) — a stricter read.

Sleep duration × regularity, walked through time

Each point is a month (12-month rolling sleep duration against 4-day consistency); the line connects them in order, earlier → later. Press play to watch the path unfold, or drag the slider.
